The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed both issues: each size keeps its lowest move count, and sizes without a record show `Best: none`. Added reload regression coverage.

All 140 unit checks and build/type checks pass. Browser results: 75 passed; two exceeded 30 seconds and passed on diagnostic reruns with more time.

Changed files pass formatting. The repository-wide check flags 17 untouched files.
